name: remote-approve-and-reject-press-enter-and-escape
description: In remote mode Approve presses Enter in the remote session and Reject presses Escape; neither types a word. Reject also clears every remote turn first, so the status leaves thinking at once.
reason: The remote session shows its own prompt, where Enter accepts and Escape declines: typing Yes or No there would answer a choice with a word. An Escape-interrupted turn never fires a Stop hook, so without the clear the light would stay amber until the turn expired.
source: DESIGN.md v1.8 remote mode (✕ = Enter, ○ = Escape); AppState.approve / reject

script.reason: Enter accepts what the remote session is asking.
Escape declines, and the turn it stops is cleared at once.
